2671: --- Check if the actor has a light armor
2672: function _M:hasLightArmor()
2673: 	if not self:getInven("BODY") then return end
2674: 	local armor = self:getInven("BODY")[1]
2675: 	if not armor or (armor.subtype ~= "cloth" and armor.subtype ~= "light" and armor.subtype ~= "mummy") then
2676: 		return nil
2677: 	end
2678: 	return armor
2679: end
